action.prompt: A spec task just completed. Before considering it done, verify the living documents are in sync per AGENTS.md §7 and §10: update .agent/spec (integrate in place, don't append), .agent/capabilities.md if a shared capability changed, .agent/learnings.md if a non-obvious decision/lesson came up, human+developer docs, CHANGELOG.md, and the version if releasable. If any could not be updated, flag it to the user rather than silently skipping.
